task.description: Review REQ-006's content per docs/agents/decisions/0002 — CONTENT-BA wrote real Cyrillic-script Kazakh translations directly into messages/kk.json (no CODE-DESIGNER step, per that decision). Review against content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules, all 5 of REQ-006's acceptance criteria (see CONTENT-BA's handoff at handoffs/WF02-REQ005-REQ006/step-07-content-ba.json for the full text), and scope (only messages/kk.json should have changed, no drive-by src/ edits). CONTENT-BA reports several ru/kk identical values claimed as legitimate untranslatable literals (names, codes, brand/URL tokens, city names) -- spot-check a sample yourself to confirm they're genuine exceptions, not missed translations. Also spot-check that the Kazakh prose reads as genuine Kazakh (not a mechanical Russian transliteration) -- you don't need fluency to sanity-check this: confirm Kazakh-specific letters actually appear distributed across many different keys (not clustered in only 2-3 places), which would suggest real translation rather than token-swapping a few words.
acceptance_criteria: git diff master...HEAD reviewed directly; scoped to messages/kk.json plus expected bookkeeping
Independent check that domain vocabulary terms use the exact stated casing/form with no synonym substitution
Independent check that status-label keys are plain lowercase Kazakh
Independent check that Metadata.ogLocale is exactly 'kk_KZ'
Independent check that Kazakh-specific letters (Ә/Ғ/Қ/Ң/Ө/Ұ/Ү/Һ/І) appear broadly distributed across the file, not clustered
Spot-check at least 5 of the claimed-identical-to-ru.json values to confirm they're legitimate untranslatable literals, not missed translations
FAIL if a genuine violation found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes
